[E]

[G#m]

[Verse 1]
[E]Unread texts and missed calls
[D#m]Told everyone I turned my phone off
[G#m]Didn't ask for help, and now I'm
[B]lost
[E]Life comes in phases
[D#m]Consequences and mistakes
[G#m]I'm sorry that it's taken me so long
[B]

[Pre-Chorus]
[E]Mister, mister please let off your po-
[D#m]wers Give me half an
[G#m]hour Or better yet a
[B]full
[E]Only sweet until it all comes sour
[D#m]But life is what you
[G#m]make it And then there's more to
[B]know

[Chorus]
[E]Gatekeeper Can you
[F#]show me more to life
[B]Mainly I've been [D#m/A#]living out of
[G#m]spite
[E]Grim Reaper Just
[F#]give me one more night
[B]I need another chance [D#m/A#]to say good-
[G#m]bye

[Bridge]
[Em]I shouldn't have to die to feel al-
[B]ive

[Verse 2]
[E]Here's the thing with disappearing
[D#m]You can yell and noone hears ya
[G#m]Times like this I need an ear
[B]When

[D#m]I could see your face
[G#m]And do what I had to stop the
[B]tears

[D#m]ry I wish it could've
[G#m]stopped me From falling off that
[B]hill

[D#m]sour But life is what you
[G#m]make it until it gets too
[B]real

[G#m]bye

[Em]I shouldn't have to die to feel
alive
